flags.behaviorGap: Repeated behavior failures on a stable task

commonChecks: Evaluate useful answers and exact constraints on held-out requests.
documentChecks: Check document permissions, freshness, retrieval coverage, and citation support.
liveChecks: Validate lookup inputs, region, timestamps, and handling of unavailable services.
actionChecks: Validate the target movie and account; require authorization for the requested action.
Check current state, make retries safe, and verify the actual execution result.
behaviorChecks: Measure the repeated failure on unseen cases; a training trial still needs a baseline comparison.

scenarios.title: Explain a supplied movie card
scenarios.description: The user provides Moonlight Map's card and wants a two-sentence summary. All required facts are already in context.

scenarios.title: Answer from a large movie archive
scenarios.description: Explain why Moonlight Map fits the user's mood, citing evidence scattered across a large, permission-controlled archive.

scenarios.title: Check tonight's availability
scenarios.description: Find whether Moonlight Map is available in the user's region right now. This exercise assumes a live service is the source of truth.

scenarios.title: Add a chosen movie
scenarios.description: The user explicitly asks to add movie M001 to their watchlist. The app must validate the request and execute an authorized state change.

scenarios.title: Improve repeated explanation style
scenarios.description: The assistant repeatedly misses a stable house style. The team has not yet evaluated a clear prompt baseline or prepared independent training and evaluation examples.

scenarios.title: Recommend, verify, and save
scenarios.description: Use the archive, check current regional availability, and save a chosen movie with authorization. A tested baseline still misses the house style; curated demonstrations and a held-out evaluation are ready.
